subject: New documentation for Renjin available online

messages.author: 39ae60762c088189
messages.subject: New documentation for Renjin available online
parts:
Hello group members,

there has been a lot of activity in this group recently and a lot questions were clearly the result of poor documentation for Renjin. We hope to fill this gap with a completely revised guide that is now available at http://docs.renjin.org. This guide is aimed at developers looking to 
  1. integrate R code in their Java applications and to exchange data between Java and R code and to
  2. create extension packages that can be used by Renjin much like packages are used to extend GNU R's functionality.
The guide also covers the parts of Renjin's Java API that should be of greatest interest to developers. We'd love to hear your feedback on the documentation. If you want to improve the documentation you can fork the sources on GitHub (https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin-docs) and send us a pull request.

Read the full announcement here: http://www.renjin.org/blog/2014-05-29-new-developer-documentation.html

The BeDataDriven Team.
